headline: President Asif Ali Zardari and PM Shehbaz Sharif paid tribute to Allama Muhammad Iqbal on his 149th birth anniversary, and the PM said a year-long commemoration begins today, culminating on 9 November next year.

card.desc: President and PM pay tribute; year-long celebration begins today.

caption:
Pakistan remembers Allama Iqbal on his 149th birth anniversary!
According to Dawn, President Asif Ali Zardari and PM Shehbaz Sharif paid tribute to national poet Allama Muhammad Iqbal in separate messages. President Zardari asked young people to take inspiration from Iqbal's poetry, and PM Shehbaz said the government will hold a year-long celebration from today until 9 November next year.
